derivation: passive participle of H103 (אָגַר); gathered (i.e. received among the sages);
def: Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon

occurrences.text: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
